coverImageAlt: A faceless figure stands on an unmarked navy compass whose cyan needle aligns branching paper paths with an orange beacon.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A plain directional compass mechanism aligning one human figure's present path with a distant objective beacon, expressing a conversational advisor that connects a person's real responsibilities and goals to concrete uses of AI.
Scene/backdrop: Open warm-paper landscape on a deep slate field, minimal and contemplative with no screens or office scene.
Subject: One dominant unmarked navy compass disc and cyan needle on the foreground plane; a simplified faceless standing figure follows the aligned needle toward a small orange beacon, with two broad nearby paths and two subtler hidden paths revealed by raking light.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail; cut-paper terrain, carved figure, machined compass, and restrained architectural modelmaking.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; sweeping but simple foreground-to-beacon alignment; compass and figure form one readable silhouette at approximately 290-pixel card width; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical and personally purposeful; restrained cyan path light with one sparing orange beacon.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Materials/textures: matte metal, carved wood, fibrous cut paper, subtle terrain relief.
Constraints: original image; one dominant alignment metaphor; compass face entirely blank with no cardinal letters, scale marks, or symbols; figure faceless; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling.
Avoid: robot assistant, smartphone, chat bubbles, magic sparkle effects, literal AI circuitry, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, Microsoft-like gradients.
Targeted correction: Pull the camera back so the complete compass disc, figure, all four path beginnings, and the orange beacon fit inside the inner 84% with a visible quiet border; remove the repeated notch or ladder-like track marks and show the two subtle paths only through smooth shallow relief and raking light, with every surface unmarked.
